documentation.content: A daily Firestore read, write or delete operation allowance exceeded 80% over the last rolling 24 hours. This may warn before the midnight-Pacific quota-day total reaches 80%. Check Firebase Usage. Keep Firebase on Spark without a billing account and Vercel on Hobby. Nearby Bluetooth remains independent of cloud quotas.
documentation.subject: Keespresso: Firestore quota above 80%

conditionPrometheusQueryLanguage.query: max(sum by (project_id, quota_metric) (increase({"serviceruntime.googleapis.com/quota/rate/net_usage",monitored_resource="consumer_quota",project_id="YOUR_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID",service="firestore.googleapis.com",quota_metric=~"firestore.googleapis.com/(read|write|delete)_operations_per_project"}[24h])) / on (project_id, quota_metric) min by (project_id, quota_metric) (last_over_time({"serviceruntime.googleapis.com/quota/limit",monitored_resource="consumer_quota",project_id="YOUR_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID",service="firestore.googleapis.com",limit_name=~"(Read|Write|Delete)OperationsPerProjectPerDay"}[24h]))) > 0.8
